answer: A workable design: force a unique proof-of-place stamp per epoch that cannot be replayed by siblings. Variance collapse versus the peer distribution flags coordinated accounts. Because it works by converting a one-time spend into a recurring per-account bill, cluster rewards are paid once, not per address. The knoll of work and the shale of evidence must both recur for the same identity, and a ridge to an external peer is the only path that releases the bond.
